meta.scope: Argentina batch 3 — Gran Buenos Aires / CABA metropolitan layer. Hierarchy: national → metro region (GBA / RMBA) → CABA entity + key partidos of the Conurbano → local statistical institutes (IDECBA + DPE Buenos Aires). Tests density of local statistical production in the largest metro.

candidates.title: Gran Buenos Aires (GBA) / Aglomerado Gran Buenos Aires — metropolitan statistical region
candidates.description: Primary metropolitan statistical region of Argentina, comprising the Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires plus the partidos of the Conurbano bonaerense. Largest urban agglomeration in the country (~15–16 million depending on exact delineation). Core domain of the EPH and of many price and activity series.
referenced_by: EPH labour and poverty results (GBA / CABA / Partidos del GBA breakdowns)
INDEC agglomeration delineations and RMBA documentation
candidates.notes: Central metro node. INDEC regularly publishes separate results for ‘Gran Buenos Aires’, ‘Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires’ and ‘Partidos del GBA’. Recent work also defines a broader Región Metropolitana Buenos Aires (RMBA) that unifies AGBA with Gran La Plata (~16.4 million in 2022 census dwellings). The GBA remains the workhorse statistical region for labour, poverty and prices.

candidates.title: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (CABA) — statistical and administrative profile
candidates.publisher: INDEC + Instituto de Estadística y Censos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (IDECBA)
candidates.region: Argentina — Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires
candidates.description: Autonomous city and federal capital. Population ~3 million. Distinct legal and statistical identity within the GBA. Local statistical production is relatively dense via IDECBA (Anuario Estadístico, own surveys and indicators).
candidates.notes: Capital node with stronger local statistical capacity than most Argentine municipalities. IDECBA (created/strengthened under Ley 6724) produces an Anuario Estadístico and coordinates the city’s statistical system. EPH and IPC still supply the national-framework series, but local packaging and additional indicators are richer than in most provinces.

candidates.title: Instituto de Estadística y Censos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (IDECBA)
candidates.publisher: Gobierno de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires
candidates.description: Local statistical institute of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. Coordinates the city’s statistical system, produces the Anuario Estadístico and other sociodemographic and economic indicators, and participates in national operatives on city territory.
candidates.notes: Strongest local statistical office in the Argentine metro hierarchy. Anuario Estadístico 2024 is a concrete recurring product. Analogous in function (though smaller in scale) to IIEG Jalisco or IPDP CDMX.

candidates.title: Partidos del Gran Buenos Aires (Conurbano) — statistical aggregate
candidates.publisher: INDEC + Dirección Provincial de Estadística de Buenos Aires
candidates.description: The set of partidos of the Province of Buenos Aires that form the Conurbano surrounding CABA. Collectively ~12–13 million inhabitants. Regularly treated as a distinct statistical domain in EPH (labour, poverty) and other national series.
referenced_by: EPH results broken out for ‘Partidos del GBA’
Poverty and labour analyses that contrast CABA vs Conurbano
Provincial statistical products of Buenos Aires
candidates.notes: Key contrast node inside the metro. Recent EPH figures show markedly higher poverty and unemployment in the Partidos del GBA than in CABA (e.g. unemployment ~9.7% vs ~4.8% in one recent quarter; poverty rates also substantially higher). Demonstrates intra-metro heterogeneity.

candidates.title: Dirección Provincial de Estadística de la Provincia de Buenos Aires
candidates.publisher: Gobierno de la Provincia de Buenos Aires
candidates.description: Provincial statistical office (DPE) that coordinates the Sistema Estadístico Provincial of Buenos Aires and participates in national operatives. Produces or compiles provincial and, where relevant, municipal-level indicators.
candidates.notes: Provincial counterpart to IDECBA. Part of the SEN architecture established by Ley 17.622. Capacity is real but thinner and more dependent on INDEC frameworks than the CABA institute for the densest urban indicators.

candidates.title: EPH — resultados para Gran Buenos Aires / CABA / Partidos del GBA
candidates.description: Geographic disaggregation of the Permanent Household Survey that regularly publishes labour-market and poverty indicators separately for the Gran Buenos Aires region, the Ciudad Autónoma, and the Partidos del GBA.
candidates.notes: The practical vehicle through which the metro layer becomes statistically visible. Allows direct comparison of CABA vs Conurbano on unemployment, informality and poverty — the main homogeneity/heterogeneity test inside the largest Argentine metro.

candidates.title: IPC — serie regional Gran Buenos Aires
candidates.description: Regional consumer-price index for the Gran Buenos Aires domain, published alongside the national total and other regions (Pampeana, Noreste, Noroeste, Cuyo, Patagonia).
candidates.notes: Price counterpart to the EPH geographic breakdowns. GBA is the densest and most closely watched regional CPI series.

candidates.title: Región Metropolitana Buenos Aires (RMBA) — expanded metropolitan delineation
candidates.description: Broader metropolitan statistical unit that unifies the Aglomerado Gran Buenos Aires with the Aglomerado Gran La Plata and related continuous urban fabric. Population in private dwellings ~16.4 million (2022 census). Newer delineation published by INDEC.
referenced_by: INDEC 2024 documentation on Región Metropolitana Buenos Aires
Academic and planning analyses of the expanded metro
candidates.notes: Emerging higher-level metro node. Not yet as routinely used in monthly/quarterly releases as the classic GBA, but already the reference for structural demographic work. Useful parent for future expansion beyond the traditional 24-partido GBA.

candidates.title: Anuario Estadístico de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires (IDECBA)
candidates.publisher: Instituto de Estadística y Censos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires
candidates.description: Annual statistical yearbook of the Autonomous City covering territory, demography, social, economic, fiscal, cultural and environmental indicators.
candidates.notes: Concrete recurring local product that packages both national series cut to CABA and city-specific indicators. Demonstrates that local statistical packaging capacity exists and is relatively strong in the capital.

candidates.title: Pobreza e indigencia en Partidos del GBA / Conurbano (EPH cut)
candidates.description: Poverty and indigency incidence specifically for the partidos of the Conurbano, regularly published as a geographic cut of the EPH-based poverty measurement.
candidates.notes: High-visibility social indicator for the densest poor belt of the metro. Recent figures show substantially higher poverty and unemployment in the Partidos del GBA than in CABA, illustrating intra-metro heterogeneity under a common national statistical framework.

proposed_edges.basis: GBA / CABA / Partidos del GBA results are geographic disaggregations of the national EPH.
GBA is one of the published regional domains of the national IPC.
CABA is the core jurisdiction of the Gran Buenos Aires statistical region.
The partidos of the Conurbano form the provincial component of the GBA.
The Anuario is the flagship annual product of IDECBA.
Conurbano poverty figures are the geographic cut of the national EPH-based poverty measurement.
IDECBA is a municipal statistical service within the broader SEN coordinated by INDEC.
The provincial statistical office is a core component of the SEN under Ley 17.622.
